verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app that routes code and prompts to hosted models. The evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, training opt-out setting, or privacy control. The option to add your own provider keys is an adjacent workaround, not a documented opt-out by the product itself.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
